summary: Frogger entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Frogger

emulation.emulator: MAME for original arcade comparison only
emulation.notes: Prefer official Arcade Archives for main play; use MAME/original hardware for timing comparison.

primary.why: The Arcade Archives release is an official modern route for the 1981 Konami arcade game, preserving the arcade target without chasing many home-port variants. Original arcade hardware/MAME remains the control/timing comparison ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official Arcade Archives release with original-style display options. Record platform, display settings, difficulty/dip-switch equivalents, input device, and whether original arcade/MAME timing was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Run a short comparison if arcade authenticity matters.
secondary.why: Arcade Archives is the practical official route, while original hardware is the historical ceiling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display/filter/assist settings and control method.
